description: This is a C++ source file for the Messenger plugin in the WPEFramework. It implements registration and API functions for joining, leaving, and sending messages in chat rooms, as well as event notifications for room and user updates.

classes.name: Messenger
classes.description: A class handling messaging operations such as join, leave, send, and event notifications.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers event listeners and API endpoints for the Messenger plugin.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all event listeners and API endpoints.

methods.name: endpoint_join
methods.description: Handles joining a chat room, returning result codes.

methods.name: endpoint_leave
methods.description: Handles leaving a chat room, returning result codes.

methods.name: endpoint_send
methods.description: Handles sending a message to a chat room, returning result codes.

methods.name: event_roomupdate
methods.description: Notifies subscribers about room status changes.

methods.name: event_message
methods.description: Notifies about new messages in a room.
